title: Higher fines for loud vehicle sound systems
summary: The council postponed a proposed change to noise violation penalties until it takes up a related committee report. Earlier, it voted eight to zero to discharge Bill 119 from committee. It then passed, seven to two, the chair's amendment replacing the bill with a version that raises fines for noise violations.

timeline.text: The council postponed a proposed change to noise violation penalties until it takes up a related committee report.
The amendment passed with seven ayes and two noes.
The chair moved to replace Bill 119 with a version that raises fines for noise violations.
The council voted eight ayes, zero noes to discharge, or release, Bill 119 from committee.
